The proposed Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the insurer challenging the judgment dated 21.02.2024, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/
District Judge, Rudraprayag in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.14 of 2023, by which, the learned Tribunal has awarded a total sum of Rs.79,59,668/- as a compensation along with an interest at the rate of 7% per annum from the date of petition till its actual payment.
2.

sentences.text: Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. Shravan Pandey, learned counsel for the appellant.

3. Learned Senior Advocate contended that as per the medical injury report of the injured (since deceased), he was intoxicated and was under the influence of alcohol at the time of accident and he (deceased) had hit the car by plying his motorcycle on the wrong side.
Issue notice to the respondent no.1, respondent no.2 and respondent no.5.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Heard on the Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2024).

8. Learned Senior Advocate has sought four weeks' time from today to deposit Rs.50,00,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Lakh) before the Tribunal concerned.
9. Subject to depositing of Rs. 50,00,000/- (Rupees Fifty Lakh), as prayed, the effect and operation of the impugned judgment dated 21.02.2024 are stayed till further order.
10. The Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2024) stands disposed of accordingly.
